current_answer: The Pollination Project accepts rolling applications for one-time seed funding up to USD 500 from individuals, informal groups, and registered not-for-profit organisations worldwide. The route is for an early-stage volunteer project under USD 10,000, with no paid staff or personal-profit purpose. It cannot pay the applicant or a family member for time or services; complete applications submitted by month-end are reviewed in the following month, and selected grantees report spending and submit receipts.

catalogue_card.question: A global USD 500 grant is open. It will not fund your salary.
catalogue_card.text: The Pollination Project accepts rolling applications for one-time seed funding up to USD 500 from individuals worldwide. The project must be early-stage, volunteer-led, non-profit, and under USD 10,000. The grant cannot pay the applicant or a family member for time or services; complete applications received by month-end are reviewed next month. Funding is not guaranteed.

summary: The Pollination Project currently shows a rolling global application for one-time seed funding up to USD 500.
